cases.case_name: Footballco Intermediate Cooperatief U.A. Netherlands Vs Board for Advance Rulings (Delhi High Court)
cases.facts: Ye ek foreign company ka case tha. Inhone advance ruling ke liye apply kiya tha. Board ne hearing ki date time pe nahi batayi.
cases.issue: Kya advance ruling ki hearing ki date 15 din ke andar applicant ko batai jaani chahiye?
cases.held: Court ne bola hearing ki date 15 din ke andar communicate karni zaroori hai. Agar nahi karte, to process galat hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap advance ruling ke liye apply karte hain, to 15 din ke andar hearing ka intzaar karein. Nahi aaye, to rectification ki demand karein.

cases.case_name: C.M. Gopal Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Assessee ke yahan search hua tha. Jewellery ki poori value ko income maan liya gaya. CBDT Instruction No. 1916 ke hisaab se kuch limit allowed thi.
cases.issue: Kya poori jewellery ko addition maana jaa sakta hai ya CBDT ki instruction se relief mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne CBDT Instruction No. 1916 follow ki aur saari jewellery addition hata di. Authority ki guidelines maani gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar ghar mein jewellery ki search ho, to CBDT ki 1916 instruction ka reference jaroor de. Uske weight limit ke hisaab se relief mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Gas Supply Co. Pvt. Ltd. Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Company ka search hua tha, par department ne section 143(3) se normal assessment kar diya. Search ke baad ka special reassessment process follow nahi kiya.
cases.issue: Kya bina sahi reassessment process follow kiye assessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki proper search procedure follow nahi hua, isliye assessment ko radd kar diya. Normal reassessment search cases mein kaam nahi aata.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke yahaan search hua hai, to department se poori procedure follow karne ka zord den. Bina process kiye assessment chal nahi sakta.

cases.case_name: Ramco Cements Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Company ne railway siding banwane par kharcha kiya. Department ne ise capital expense maana, revenue expense nahi.
cases.issue: Kya railway siding ka kharcha direct expense hai ya capital?
cases.held: ITAT ne allow kiya ki ye expense revenue hai, bas department ko verify karna hai. Sab kuch records par depend karega.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka infrastructure ka kharcha hai, to detail mein proof rakhein. Verification ke liye bill, agreement sab ready rakho.

cases.case_name: National Housing Bank Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Bank ne leasehold office premises ke composite cost par depreciation claim kiya tha. Department ne poora amount allow nahi kiya.
cases.issue: Kya composite cost par depreciation mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola poore composite cost par depreciation mil sakta hai. Department ko is baar sahi tariqe se allow karna padega.
cases.takeaway: Agar leasehold office ya aise asset hai, to composite cost par depreciation ka claim submit karo. Sahi working aur break-up ready rakho.

cases.case_name: Quess Corp Ltd. Vs Wardwiz (India) Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Quess Corp ne IBC demand notice wrong pin code par bheja, lekin notice phir bhi deliver ho gaya. Dusri party ne is par objection uthaya ki pin code galat tha.
cases.issue: Kya wrong pin code hone par bhi notice valid hai jab delivery ho gayi ho?
cases.held: NCLAT ne matter wapas bhej diya, par bola ki galat pin code hone se notice khatam nahi ho sakta, agar actual mein serve ho gaya ho.
cases.takeaway: IBC notice bhejte waqt address details sahi hon, phir bhi agar notice pohanch jaaye, to technical error se matter nahi ruke. Delivery prove ho to relief milega.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Deep Raheja (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Deep Raheja ke yahan income tax department ne search ke baad scrutiny assessment kiya. Assessment Rs 3.05 crore par kiya gaya tha. Department ne search ke aadhaar par additional demand nikaali thi.
cases.issue: Kya search ke aadhaar par ki gayi assessment sahi thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne yeh assessment radd kar diya. Court ne kaha search ki jo basic requirements thi, wo poori nahi hui thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar department aapke khilaaf search assessment rakhe, to check karo ki sab requirements poori ki gayi ya nahi. Galat tareeke se hui assessment ko ITAT radd kar sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Angpal Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Angpal ka accountant resign kar gaya tha, isliye filing mein delay ho gaya. Income tax department ne Rs 1.5 lakh ka penalty lagaya tha kyunki return ya statement late file hua tha.
cases.issue: Kya accountant ke resign karne ki wajah se delay justifiable hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty hata di. Bola ki accountant ke chhorne ki wajah se genuine problem thi, isliye late ho gaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar statement file karne mein delay ho to proof rakho ki kyon delay hua. Genuine reason jaise employee resign ka record kaam aa sakta hai.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Chrysalis Trading Pvt. Ltd. (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: DCIT ne company ke upar section 153C lagaya tha, jo dusre ke documents milne par lagta hai. Satisfaction note defective tha.
cases.issue: Kya defective satisfaction note se assessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne section 153C ki assessment radd kar di kyunki satisfaction note theek se nahi likha gaya tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case mein section 153C lag raha hai, to satisfaction note dhyan se check karo. Galat ya adhura note ho to assessment radd ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Hamdard Laboratories India Vs DCIT. (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Hamdard Laboratories India ne apni books mein depreciation claim kiya tha. Department ne Rs 4.72 lakh ka depreciation disallow kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya depreciation disallowance justified tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne yeh disallowance hata diya. Bola ki depreciation claim genuine tha.
cases.takeaway: Depreciation claim ke liye books ki entries aur asset ka use dikhana zaroori hai. Agar sab kuch proper hai to disallowance cancel ho sakta hai.

cases.facts: Union Bank ne excess GST refund claim kiya tha. Department ne limitation ka calculation dispute kiya. Mudda tha ki limitation period har mahine alag se count hoga ya ek hi saal mein.
cases.issue: GST refund ki limitation ka calculation har mahine alag hoga ya total period ke hisaab se?
cases.held: GSTAT ne bola GST refund ka limitation period har mahine ki GSTR-3B filing se alag-alag count hoga, ek saal ekathe nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap har mahine GST refund claim karte ho, to limitation ka dhyaan rakhna hai. Har mahine ki GSTR-3B filing ke hisaab se alag-alag time limit count hogi.

cases.case_name: Rahul Singhal Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Is case mein assessee ke kharche ko fake purchase bola gaya tha. Lekin sales aur stock records department ne maan liye the.
cases.issue: Kya bogus purchase add karna sahi tha jab sales aur stock record sahi the?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha ki agar sales aur stock records pe government ko bharosa hai to fir purchase ko naksali nahi bol sakte. Fake purchase ki addition hata di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke sales aur stock records consistent hain, to sirf purchase ko bogus bolke addition nahi ho sakta.

cases.case_name: GR Infra Projects Limited Ratlam Vs State of Madhya Pradesh and Others (Madhya Pradesh High Court)
cases.facts: Company ko GST ka notice mila Section 74 mein, jisme ke fraud ka clear ilzaam nahi lagaya gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina specific fraud allegation ke Section 74 ka notice valid hai?
cases.held: Court ne notice radd kar diya, bola jab tak seedha fraud ka ilzaam nahi hai, Section 74 notice nahi chal sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar GST department aapko fraud wale section mein notice de aur koi specific fraud ka charge nahi likhe, to aap notice radd karwa sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Anil Agarwal HUF Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Reassessment ki notice bheji gayi thi, lekin Section 143(2) ka notice nahi diya gaya.
cases.issue: Kya bina Section 143(2) notice ke reassessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment ko radd kar diya, bola bina mandatory notice bheje reassessment nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Aapko agar reassessment notice aaye aur Section 143(2) ka alag se notice na aaye, to pura reassessment radd ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Shanta Blankets Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Assessee se cash credits ke source pooche gaye the. Usne identity, paisa kahan se aaya aur transaction asli hai ya nahi, sabit kiya.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 mein addition tab bhi rahegi jab assessee teeno cheeze prove kar de?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di, bola jab teeno cheezon ka proof hai to Section 68 ka addition nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Aapko Section 68 ke case mein teen cheezon ka proof dikhana hai - identity, paisa kahan se aaya aur transaction asli hai ya nahi. Ye ho gaya to addition nahi banegi.

cases.case_name: Exclusive Motors Pvt. Ltd. Vs Sapan Mohan Garg (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: CoC ne insolvency resolution plan pe limited cheezon pe hi vapas review karna tha. Lekin poore plan ko firse dekhne ko shuru kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya CoC purane resolution plan ko firse pura dekh sakti hai jab sirf kuch muddon par hi review bola gaya ho?
cases.held: NCLAT ne bola ki limited muddon par hi vapas dekhna allowed hai. Poora plan firse mat kholo.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka insolvency plan sirf kuch points ke liye court ne wapas bheja hai, to sirf wahi points dubara dekhe jayenge, poora plan nahi.

cases.case_name: Jagmal Vs Mangal Sales Corporation Through Its Proprietor & Anr. (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Admission se pehle settlement ho gaya tha. Phir bhi insolvency ka order aa gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya admission se pehle party settle kar le to insolvency ki proceedings chal sakti hain?
cases.held: NCLAT ne insolvency order khatam kar diya, bola settlement ho gaya tha to process nahi chalegi.
cases.takeaway: Agar insolvency admission se pehle hi settlement ho jaye, to Section 9 ka process nahi chalega. Order cancel ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Quanta Logistics Pvt. Ltd. Vs Commissioner of Customs (Import-I) (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: Customs department ne apne order mein AI-generated Supreme Court judgments ka rujhan liya jo asli nahi the. Bombay HC ne order ko challenge par quash kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya fake ya AI-generated citation pe adharit customs order valid hai?
cases.held: Bombay HC ne order radd kar diya. Bola, fake case law ya AI judgement pe adharit order nahi chal sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar order mein department ne fake ya AI-generated citation dikhayi ho, to aap High Court jaake poora order radd karwa sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Exclusive Motors Pvt. Ltd. Vs Sapan Mohan Garg (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Ye case ek company ke insolvency process ka tha. CoC (Committee of Creditors) ko wapas sirf kuch muddon pe decide karne ko bola gaya tha. Lekin CoC puri resolution plan ko dobara dekhna chahta tha.
cases.issue: Kya CoC poore resolution plan ko fir se consider kar sakta hai jab sirf kuch hi muddon pe remand hua ho?
cases.held: NCLAT ne bola ki CoC sirf wapas bheje gaye specific muddon pe hi deciding power rakhta hai. Pura plan dobara nahi khol sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar court ya tribunal sirf kuch hi cheezein wapas bheje, to CoC ya creditors pura plan nahi khol sakte, sirf wahi mudde decide honge jo specifically remand pe aaye hain.

cases.case_name: Anil Agarwal HUF Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Tax department ne assessee ke khilaf reassessment proceeding start ki. Par assessee ko mandatory notice nahi diya gaya jo Section 143(2) me required hai.
cases.issue: Kya bina Section 143(2) ka notice bheje reassessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment ko radd kar diya. Bola ki notice dena mandatory hai, bina iske pura case hi khatam ho jata hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar reassessment hua hai to Section 143(2) ka notice dekhna zaroori hai. Agar notice ni mila to poora assessment radd ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Jagmal Vs Mangal Sales Corporation Through Its Proprietor & Anr. (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Is case me insolvency ki application file hui thi. Lekin jab tak application admit nahi hui thi, tabhi parties ka settlement ho gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya agar admission se pehle settlement ho jaye to CIRP chalu reh sakta hai?
cases.held: NCLAT ne insolvency order radd kar diya. Bola, admission se pehle agar compromise ya settlement ho jaye to Section 9 ke tahat CIRP nahi chal sakta.
cases.takeaway: Insolvency ki application admit hone se pehle settlement ho jaye to turant uska proof lagwa ke application close karwa lo.

cases.case_name: Shanta Blankets Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Assessee par section 68 lagaya gaya tha kyunki uske accounts me kuch credits the jin ki genuineness department ko doubtful lagi. Assessee ne identity, creditworthiness aur transaction ki sagai dikhadi.
cases.issue: Kya section 68 ka addition tab bhi ho sakta hai jab assessee sab proofs dikhade?
cases.held: ITAT ne section 68 ka addition hata diya kyunki assessee ne identity, creditworthiness aur genuineness sab clear dikhayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke account me kisi se paisa aaya hai, to unka PAN, bank statement, aur paisa aane ki wajah clear dikhana zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Ito Vs NDW Development Corporation LLP (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Tax department ne ek loan ko unexplained money bol ke addition kar diya. Yeh sirf loan ka ledger head reclassify kiya gaya tha, actual mein fresh entry nahi thi.
cases.issue: Kya sirf entry ka naam badalne se woh unexplained ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola sirf reclassification se addition nahi banti. Jab paisa already disclose hua tha, toh uska sirf naam badalna unexplained nahi banata.
cases.takeaway: Aap apne books me kis entry ko kya naam dete ho, uski clear note rakhna chahiye. Sirf terminology ki wajah se addition nahi hoga jab paisa explain ho chuka hai.

cases.case_name: Quanta Logistics Pvt. Ltd. Vs Commissioner of Customs (Import-I) (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: Customs department ne apni order me AI-generated Supreme Court judgment ka reference de diya, jo asli mein exist nahi karti. Importer ne is basis par High Court me challenge kiya.
cases.issue: Kya AI-fabricated judgment pe based order valid hai?
cases.held: Bombay HC ne customs order radd kar diya. Bola ki fabricated ya jhooti judgment pe koi bhi order valid nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke khilaf order aaya hai aur court citation ya judgment lag fake lag raha hai, to usko proof ke saath turant challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Margaret Smith Brahm Bagh Vs DCIT (International Taxation) (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Margaret Smith Brahm Bagh ka case tha. Department ne section 54 exemption isliye deny ki, kyunki unhone original return nahi file kiya tha. Property bechne par capital gain declare nahi hua tha original return me.
cases.issue: Kya section 54 exemption mil sakta hai agar original return nahi file kiya ho?
cases.held: ITAT Jaipur ne mana ki exemption dena mana nahi kiya ja sakta sirf is wajah se ki original return nahi file hua. Court ne assessee ko section 54 ka benefit diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapne original return miss kar diya ho, phir bhi section 54 exemption mil sakta hai. Late return me claim hone par bhi consider hota hai.

cases.case_name: Aavkar Trade Consultants LLP Vs ITO (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: Ye reassessment ka case tha ek aisi LLP ka jo pehle hi defunct ho chuki thi. Department ne us LLP ke naam par notice bheja.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment proceeding chal sakti hai defunct company ke PAN par?
cases.held: Bombay High Court ne keh diya ki defunct company ka PAN use karke assessment ya reassessment nahi chal sakte. Notice radd ho gaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar company ya LLP band ho gayi ho, uske naam par notice valid nahi hai. Defunct entity pe koi action nahi le sakte.

cases.case_name: Omprakash Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Omprakash ne property bech kar cash liya. Department ne penalty laga di section 271D ke under kyunki cash mein transaction hui.
cases.issue: Kya cash mein property sale par 271D penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT Jaipur ne dekha ki practical challenges the aur koi mala fide intention nahi tha. Penalty hata di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Property sale ya other transaction cash mein ho toh bhi penalty nahi lagegi agar koi genuine reason ho aur mala fide nahi ho.

cases.case_name: Satya Narayan Garg Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Satya Narayan Garg par 11.52 lakh rupees ki addition kar di gayi section 69C ke under, jo unexplained expenditure ka section hai.
cases.issue: Kya unexplained expenditure ka addition section 69C mein sahi tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition quash kar di. Department adequate evidence nahi de paya ki actual unexplained expenditure hua tha.
cases.takeaway: Section 69C mein addition tabhi chalegi jab department proper evidence de ki kharcha unexplained hai. Aise hi estimate par addition nahi ho sakti.

cases.case_name: Manish Bhatia Kalani & Co. LLP Vs ACIT (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Manish Bhatia Kalani & Co. LLP ki books mein 62 lakh cash entries thi. Department ne is basis par reassessment start kiya.
cases.issue: Kya sirf cash entries ke basis par reassessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT Jaipur ne reassessment radd kar diya. Keh diya ki sirf cash entries mention kar dena kaafi nahi hai, specific material hona chahiye.
cases.takeaway: Agar sirf cash entry ya vague reason ho reassessment ke liye, toh usko challenge karo. Concrete evidence chahiye department ko.

cases.case_name: CIT Vs Deccan Education Society (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Deccan Education Society ek trust hai jo education field mein hai. Department ne unki section 10(23C)(iiiab) exemption pe objection uthayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya trust ko 10(23C)(iiiab) ka benefit milega?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne trust ko relief de diya. Section 10(23C)(iiiab) ka benefit available hai agar conditions fulfill ho rahi hai.
cases.takeaway: Educational trust agar eligible criteria pura karta ho to section 10(23C)(iiiab) ka benefit mil sakta hai, chahe department object kare.

cases.case_name: CIT Vs Deccan Education Society (Supreme Court of India)
cases.section: Section 10(23C)(iiiab) – ye Government funded educational institutions ke income ko tax free karta hai.
cases.facts: Deccan Education Society ek educational trust hai. Inhone apne educational activities par income tax exemption mangi. Dept ne is par objection kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya Deccan Education Society ko Section 10(23C)(iiiab) waali tax chhoot mil sakti hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne kaha – agar ek society government grant se chalti hai, to uski educational income par tax nahi lagega, Section 10(23C)(iiiab) ke hesaab se.
cases.takeaway: Agar school ya college fully government grant par chalta hai, to income tax exemption mil sakti hai. Apne saare government grant papers ready rakho aur sahi section likho.

cases.case_name: SPI Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: SPI Technologies ek export company hai. US mein sales ke liye ₹8.81 crore ka commission diya. Dept ne bola ki bina TDS kaat ke payment hua hai, isliye expense disallow kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya foreign commission par bina TDS kaate expense allowed hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha – ye commission business ke bahar, foreign agent ko diya gaya hai, aur TDS ki requirement nahi thi. Dept ka disallowance hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap foreign agent ko India ke bahar commission dete ho, toh har case mein TDS zaruri nahi. Agreement aur work location ka dhyan rakho.

cases.case_name: Kushal Jain Vs DCIT (ITAT Jodhpur)
cases.facts: Kushal Jain ki salary par dept ne ₹25,000 ka ekstra taxable income add kiya. Par employer ne pehle hi settlement kar di thi.
cases.issue: Kya income pehle hi employer settlement mein cover ho to dobara tax ho sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne yeh addition hata di. Bola, jab employer ne already settlement de diya hai to dobara tax nahi lag sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar employer settlement ya payment letter hai, woh audit ya assessment ke time dikha do. Duplicate addition nahi hone dena.

cases.case_name: Leela Devi Jain Vs ITO (ITAT Raipur)
cases.section: Section 151 – income tax reassessment start karne ki approver authority.
cases.facts: Leela Devi Jain ka case dubara khola (reassessment). Lekin approval galat authority se li gayi thi jo section 151 mein allowed nahi hai.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment approval sahi officer ne nahi diya to puri karwahi valid hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment wapas kar di. Bola, galat authority ki approval pe action nahi chal sakta.
cases.takeaway: Aapko reassessment notice mile toh approval officer ka naam zarur check karo. Galat officer hai toh challenge kar do.

cases.case_name: Income Tax Gazetted Officers Association (ITGOA) & Ors. Vs Union of India & Ors. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Income Tax Gazetted Officers Association ne apne salary aur policy ki problems government ke samne uthani chahi. Department ya sarkar sun nahi rahi thi.
cases.issue: Kya Association ko 8th Pay Commission ke saamne apni baat rakhne ka haq hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne bola ki Association apni complaint 8th Pay Commission ke saamne le ja sakti hai. Court ne yeh permission de di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap kisi staff body, association ya union mein ho, toh government forums mein directly representation ki permission mil sakti hai, Supreme Court ki guidelines ke hesaab se.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Prakash Chandra (ITAT Indore)
cases.facts: Yahan ek vyakti ne apni books mein cash sales dikhayi thi. Department ne wahi amount ko fir se Section 68 ke tehat taxable maana. Sath mein ₹10 lakh ki gift ka bhi mamla tha.
cases.issue: Kya jo cash sales books mein proper dikhayi gayi ho, uspe fir se Section 68 lag sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne bola, agar cash sales books mein sahi dikhai gayi hai, to Section 68 dubara nahi lag sakta. ₹10 lakh gift ka mamla further enquiry ke liye wapas bhej diya gaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap cash sales pe Section 68 ka notice paayein, books ki entries ko ache se reconcile karo. Gift ya loan jaise items ka proper evidence tayyar rakho, warna woh matter wapas inquiry ke liye ja sakta hai.

cases.case_name: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Chandigarh)
cases.section: Section 271(1)(c) (Penalty on concealment of income), Section 14A (Disallowance for exempt income)
cases.facts: Yahan ek engineering company ki income par Section 14A ke tehat kuch disallowance estimate ki gayi. Uspe department ne penalty bhi laga di Section 271(1)(c) ke tehat.
cases.issue: Kya estimated disallowance par penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne penalty hata di. Bola, agar disallowance sirf estimate par hai, toh penalty nahi lag sakti.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case mein Section 14A par koi figure estimate hui hai, us basis pe penalty lage to appeal jarur dalein. Tribunal ne estimate par penalty galat mani hai.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Zen Matrix Private Limited (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Company ke fixed assets par deemed rent maana gaya aur usko tax kiya gaya. Lekin jo stock-in-trade tha uski addition hata di gayi.
cases.issue: Fixed assets pe deemed rent lagana sahi hai ya nahi? Kya stock-in-trade add kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne bola, fixed assets pe deemed rent theek hai. Par stock-in-trade pe addition galat thi, isliye woh hata di.
cases.takeaway: Company assets ka nature sahi classify karo. Fixed assets rent maane ja sakte hain, magar stock-in-trade par nahi. Classification point pe records strong rakho.

cases.case_name: Pooja Agarwal Vs ITO (ITAT Agra)
cases.facts: Yahan cash handler ke khilaaf ₹3.70 crore ka addition Section 69A se kiya gaya. Unhone paison ki source ke papers diye.
cases.issue: Kya cash handler ke pass milne wali rakam Section 69A mein add ki ja sakti hai jab source dikh gaya ho?
cases.held: Tribunal ne evidence man liye aur poori addition hata di. Bola, jab paison ka proper source hai to Section 69A nahi lagta.
cases.takeaway: Jab bhi cash ka mamla ho, uske original source ke documents tayyar raho. Sahi proof hai to addition hat sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Rajlaxmi Petrochem Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Yahan company ka reassessment kiya gaya, baad mein Section 263 ke tehat bhi revision hua. Lekin original reopening ke grounds galat sabit hue.
cases.issue: Kya reopening aur 263 revision, jab pehli reopening hi galat sabit ho jaye?
cases.held: Tribunal ne reassessment aur Section 263 dono ko radd kar diya. Bola, agar pehli reopening ki wajah hi galat thi, to aage ka pura process khatam.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke assessment ke reopening ke reason hi weak ho, toh har subsequent revision bhi challenge ho sakta hai. Original reopening grounds ko evidence se zaroor check karein.

cases.case_name: Venkateswara Agencies Vs Assistant Commissioner (ST) & Others (Andhra Pradesh High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan ek GST assessment order ke khilaaf case tha. Order mein DIN number nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina DIN number wale GST order ko court mein challenge kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: High Court ne order ko radd kar diya, kyunki DIN (Document Identification Number) nahi tha. Bola, DIN ki requirement mandatory hai.
cases.takeaway: Har GST order par DIN honi chaiye. Agar nahi hai to turant legal action sochiye; order cancel ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Prakash Chandra (ITAT Indore)
cases.facts: Prakash Chandra ka case tha. Business ke cash sales books mein record ho chuki thi. Department ne fir bhi 10 lakh ka gift Section 68 ke tahat dubara income maan liya.
cases.issue: Kya already books mein dikhaye gaye cash sales dobara Section 68 mein add ho sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, agar cash sales pehle hi books mein record hain to Section 68 se dobara tax nahi kar sakte. 10 lakh ka gift ka hisaab sahi se verify karne ke liye matter wapas Assessing Officer ko bhej diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar cash sales seedhe books mein dikhai ho to officer dobara Section 68 se tax nahi laga sakta. Par gift ya loan ke case mein proof dena zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Chandigarh)
cases.section: Section 271(1)(c) (penalty for concealment) aur Section 14A (expenditure on exempt income)
cases.facts: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Limited par Section 14A ki estimation basis par expenditure disallow hone par penalty lagayi gayi thi. Company ne argue ki penalty nahi banti.
cases.issue: Estimated Section 14A disallowance pe penalty lagana sahi hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha ke jab disallowance sirf estimate pe ho, to Section 271(1)(c) ki penalty nahi lagayi ja sakti. Penalty ko hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka Section 14A ka disallowance sirf estimate pe hai, to us basis pe penalty nahi lagni chahiye. Department agar lagata hai to appeal kijiye.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Zen Matrix Private Limited (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Zen Matrix Pvt Ltd ka case tha. Department ne fixed assets pe deemed rent maana aur stock-in-trade pe bhi addition kari.
cases.issue: Kya fixed assets pe deemed rent lagana theek hai aur stock-in-trade ka addition valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, fixed assets pe deemed rent lag sakta hai. Lekin, stock-in-trade pe addition galat tha, wo hata di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Fixed assets agar vacant hai to deemed rent add ho sakta hai, lekin stock-in-trade pe addition ke liye sahi basis dikhana padega.

cases.case_name: Pooja Agarwal Vs ITO (ITAT Agra)
cases.facts: Pooja Agarwal ka case tha. Uske khilaf Rs. 3.70 crore ki addition section 69A ke tahat ki gayi thi cash handling ke basis par.
cases.issue: Kya cash handler ke khilaf section 69A ki addition sahi thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di. Lagta hai court ko justification theek nahi laga.
cases.takeaway: Cash ke source ka proof sahi hai to section 69A ki addition delete ho sakti hai. Jab bhi cash transaction ho, sari entry aur receipts sambhal kar rakho.

cases.case_name: Rajlaxmi Petrochem Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Rajlaxmi Petrochem Pvt. Ltd. ka case hai. Department ne pehle reassessment kiya, fir Section 263 ke tahat order revise kiya. Par jo pehle reopening ke reasons the, wo fail ho gaye.
cases.issue: Agar asli reopening ke reasons fail ho jayein to reassessment aur revision survive karte hain ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment aur Section 263 dono orders ko radd kar diya kyunki original reopening ground hi fail ho gaya tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapki reassessment sirf galat ya fail reason par hai to usko challenge karo. Department har case mein dobaara revision nahi kar sakta.

cases.case_name: Venkateswara Agencies Vs Assistant Commissioner (ST) & Others (Andhra Pradesh High Court)
cases.facts: Venkateswara Agencies ka GST assessment order tha. Uspe DIN (Document Identification Number) nahi tha. Department ne order pass kar diya bina DIN ke.
cases.issue: Kya bina DIN ke GST assessment order valid hai?
cases.held: High Court ne GST order bina DIN ke radd kar diya. DIN ka hona mandatory hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke GST order pe DIN nahi hai to turant usko challenge karo. DIN compulsory hai, bina uske order nahi chal sakta.

cases.case_name: Sandeep Gupta Vs JM Financial Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd. & Anr. (NCLAT New Delhi)
cases.facts: Asian Hotels insolvency chal raha tha. CoC ne full-dues settlement proposal aaya tha, lekin bina theek wajah ke mana kar diya. Company ne challenge kiya yeh decision.
cases.issue: Kya CoC settlement offer bina reason ke reject kar sakta hai?
cases.held: NCLAT ne insolvency process ko radd kar diya. Bola CoC ka rejection arbitrary tha, har proposal ka logic se evaluation zaroori hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap CoC hain, settlement ko bina explanation reject mat karo. Har decision ka likhit reason hona chahiye, warna process khatam ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Ashutosh Bhargava Vs PCIT (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Assessee ka Section 263 revision notice aaya. Department ne poora mauka nahi diya jawab dene ka. Sunwai properly nahi hui.
cases.issue: Kya bina theek sunwai ke Section 263 revision valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne revision ko radd kar diya. Kaaha, fair hearing ke bina aisa revision notice nahi chal sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko Section 263 ka notice mile, department ko likhit jawab dene ka mauka maange aur sunwai proper ho toh hi action valid maana jaayega.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Skyway Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd. (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Company ne unsecured loan liya. Department ne loans add back kiye kyunki creditworthiness aur genuineness prove nahi hui.
cases.issue: Unsecured loan tab allow hoga jab assessee prove kare ki paisa legit hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne additions ko uphold kiya. Bola, proof ki kami thi ki paisa sach mein loan tha ya nahi, isliye disallow kiya.
cases.takeaway: Aap unsecured loan le rahe ho toh, lender ka bank statement aur source of funds ka proper proof ready rakho. Sirf entry se kaam nahi chalega.

cases.case_name: Samriddhi Petro Products Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Company par Section 263 ke tahat revision proceedings shuru ho gayi. Assessee ko poori sunwai ka mauka nahi mila.
cases.issue: Kya bina sunwai ke Section 263 revision chal sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne case wapas department ko bhej diya fresh sunwai ke liye. Bola bina full hearing ke order pass nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Section 263 ka notice aaye to apni taraf se har proof jama karwao aur proper sunwai ka demand likhit mein karo.

cases.case_name: Union of India Vs M.T.N.L. & Anr. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: BOCW Cess matter me appeal file karne ke liye pre-deposit maanga gaya tha. Parties ne is pre-deposit ki legality Delhi HC me challenge ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya BOCW Cess appeal me pre-deposit ka rule valid hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne Delhi HC ka decision barkarar rakha, interfere nahi kiya. Matlab pre-deposit ka rule bana raha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko BOCW Cess pe appeal file karni hai, toh pre-deposit ke rule ki tayari pehle se kar lo, bina paisa deposit kiye appeal entertain nahi hogi.

cases.case_name: Anilkumar Khanderao Pawar Vs Directorate of Enforcement & Anr. (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: ED ne ek aadmi ko evidence ke bina arrest kar liya. Accused ne arrest ko challenge kiya court mein.
cases.issue: Kya bina pakke evidence ke ED kisi ko arrest kar sakti hai?
cases.held: Bombay HC ne bola ki tangible evidence ke bina arrest galat hai. ED ko law follow karna hoga.
cases.takeaway: Agar ED summon ya arrest kare to proper documents maange aur bina evidence ke arrest ya investigation ko turant challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Ritu Agarwal Vs ACIT (ITAT Lucknow)
cases.section: Section 271(1)(c) - Penalty for concealment/misreporting of income
cases.facts: Ritu Agarwal ka case tha. Tax officer ne penalty lagayi Section 271(1)(c) mein, par notice aur order mein alag alag charge likh diya. Penalty isi confusion pe based thi.
cases.issue: Jab notice aur order mein alag alag reason ho penalty ka, to penalty valid hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty radd kar di. Bola, agar notice aur order mein mismatch ho jaye toh assessee ko clear nahi pata ki uspar kya ilzam hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko penalty ka notice aaye aur usme aur order mein alag-alag reason likha ho, toh is point ko appeal mein utha sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Aegis Customer Support Services Pvt Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Aegis Customer Support Services Pvt Ltd par ₹37.95 crore ka CCD interest TP adjustment lagaya gaya. ₹6.53 crore ka service charges bhi dispute tha.
cases.issue: TP adjustment mein interest aur service charges ko kaise treat karein?
cases.held: ITAT ne ₹37.95 crore ka TP adjustment hata diya. ₹6.53 crore service charges wapas department ko jaane bhej diye further check ke liye.
cases.takeaway: Aapke TP adjustment case mein interest waale part pe strong facts ho toh relief mil sakti hai. Service charges jaise items department mein properly justify karne honge.

cases.case_name: Mahaveer Jeerawala Vs DCIT (ITAT Jodhpur)
cases.facts: Mahaveer Jeerawala ka completed assessment pe search hua. Department ne Section 153A ke under naya addition kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya poore ho chuke assessment mein bina naya material ke addition ho sakta hai search ke baad?
cases.held: ITAT ne saaf bola, jab tak search mein naya incriminating material nahi milta, completed assessment mein additions nahi ho sakte.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka assessment search ke pehle complete tha aur search mein kuch naya nahi mila, additions challenge kar sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Vikas Jain Vs DC Central Circle-2 (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Vikas Jain par penny stock ka addition ho gaya. Par search/raid mein koi naya proof nahi mila jo directly uske case ko connect karta ho.
cases.issue: Bina naya search material ke, kya penny stock addition valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di, bola bina incriminating search material ke addition nahi ho sakta under search assessment.
cases.takeaway: Penny stock ya any addition agar search ke baad kiye hain to check karein ki kya actual incriminating material mila bhi tha ya nahi.

cases.facts: Ek aadmi par SIL license ke wrong use ka ilzam tha. Department ne bola customs broker (CB) ki galti hai over-debiting mein. Lekin department apne pass proof nahi dikha paya ki broker ka actual role tha ya nahi.
cases.issue: Kya bina proof ke customs broker par zimmedari daali ja sakti hai?
cases.held: CESTAT ne bola department ne sahi tarah se CB ka role establish nahi kiya. Appeal allow ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap customs broker hain aur department aap par zimmedari daal raha hai, to proof ki demand karein. Sirf ilzam se zimmedari nahi aati.

cases.case_name: Shree Madhi Vibhag Khand Udyog Sahakari Mandli Ltd. Vs PCIT (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Yeh co-operative bank ka case tha. Department ne Section 263 ka use karke interest deduction ko lekar revision kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya department Section 263 lagakar co-operative bank ke interest deduction ko wapas khol sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne revision ko radd kar diya. Court ko laga ki department ki taraf se galat tareeke se revision li gayi thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap co-operative entity hain aur interest deduction sahi diya hai, to Section 263 ke through galat revision court mein tik nahi sakti.

cases.case_name: Vodafone Digilink Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Vodafone par ₹296.15 crore ka transfer pricing adjustment lagaya gaya tha, mainly royalty aur AMP (advertisement/marketing) expenses ko lekar.
cases.issue: Kya royalty aur AMP expenses par transfer pricing adjustment sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne Vodafone ke khilaf ki gayi transfer pricing adjustment ko hata diya. Unhone dekha ki yeh expenses business ke hisaab se valid the.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap royalty ya marketing expenses par transfer pricing adjustment face kar rahe hain, to har ek expense ko business purpose aur agreement ke document se justify karna zaruri hai.

cases.case_name: Girdharlal Brothers Vs ACIT/JCIT/DCIT/ACIT/ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Girdharlal Brothers ne tenancy rights surrender kiye the. Department ne value uthane ke liye Section 50C lagaya aur ₹38.48 lakh ka addition kiya.
cases.issue: Kya tenancy rights ke surrender par Section 50C lagti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya. Bola ki Section 50C sirf immovable property transfer par lagti hai, tenancy rights par nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap tenancy rights surrender kar rahe hain, to Section 50C ka valuation provision aap par nahi lagega.

cases.case_name: Khathu Shyam Jangid Brahman Dharamshala Vs ITO (E) (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Dharamshala ko Section 12AA ka registration appeal ke dauraan mila. Pehle ke assessment year ke liye exemption claim kiya.
cases.issue: Kya appeal mein registration milne par pehle ke year ka exemption mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki registration milte hi pichhle saal ka bhi exemption mil jaata hai.
cases.takeaway: Trusts/NGOs ko appeal mein registration mil jaaye to pichhle years ki exemption bhee claim ki ja sakti hai.

cases.facts: Ek company par ₹3.83 crore ka CVD (Additional Duty of Customs) demand lagaya tha. Laptops free distribute kiye ja rahe the aur RSP (retail sale price) declare nahi ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya bina RSP declare kiye free laptops par RSP-based CVD lag sakta hai?
cases.held: CESTAT ne demand ko radd kar diya. Court ne bola ki jab statutory authority nahi hai, to free laptops par RSP-based CVD nahi lag sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap free gifts (jaise laptops) import kar rahe hain to RSP declare na karne par RSP-based CVD nahi lagega, jab tak competent authority ka order nahi ho.

cases.case_name: Amity Land Developers Vs Assessing Officer (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Ye case ek land developer ka tha. Department ne Land ki sale value kam batane par ₹27.22 lakh ka addition kiya under Section 50C (jo stamp value aur sale value compare karta hai).
cases.issue: DVO ki report per trust karna hai ya nahi, ye tha asli sawal.
cases.held: ITAT ne case wapas bhej diya Assessing Officer ko aur DVO report ko dhang se consider karne ko bola. Matlab addition turant confirm nahi hua.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapki property ki valuation per dispute hai, toh DVO report ki copy mangaye aur us par timely objection dijiye.

cases.case_name: Krinal Gems Vs Income Tax Unit (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Ye ek gems firm ka case tha. Department ne bogus purchases maan kar ₹13.10 lakh penalty lagayi thi, sirf estimates ke basis par.
cases.issue: Kya estimate basis par penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne sari penalty hata di, kyunki only estimate se penalty nahi lag sakti.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap par sirf estimate basis par penalty lagi ho, toh uske khilaf appeal karna strong ground hai.

cases.case_name: Malik Khan Vs Chief Commissioner GST and Central Excise & Anr. (Rajasthan High Court)
cases.facts: Ye GST ka case tha jahan ek vyakti ne direct High Court mein writ petition file ki, jabki normal appeal ka limitation period khatam ho chuka tha.
cases.issue: Limitation period ke baad High Court mein seedha writ file kar sakte hain ya nahi?
cases.held: Court ne writ dismiss kar diya. Bola pehle se jo appeal ka time tha, woh important hai, uske baad seedha High Court nahi aa sakte.
cases.takeaway: GST order milte hi appeal time ka dhyan rakho. Limitation miss ho jaye toh High Court direct jane ka fayda nahi.

cases.case_name: Abdul Rahim Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Is case mein income estimate kar ke 5% mana gaya tha aur us par concealment ki penalty lagayi gayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya estimated income par Section 271(1)(c) ki penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty hata di. Sif estimation se concealment prove nahi hoti.
cases.takeaway: Agar sirf estimate se penalty lagi hai toh strong ground hai appeal jeetne ka.

cases.case_name: Kallu Ram Vs ITO (ITAT Raipur)
cases.facts: Ek 94 saal ke kisaan ka case tha. Unhone 388 din late appeal file ki thi.
cases.issue: Jyada late hone pe bhi appeal sunni chahiye ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne delay condone kar diya, reason genuine maana. Case wapas CIT(A) ko bhej diya fresh decision ke liye.
cases.takeaway: Agar solid reason ho, toh appeal mein late filing bhi consider ho sakti hai. Age aur medical ground bhi kaam aa sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Pranav Kirit Inamdar Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Is case mein assessee ne NCD finance interest ₹73.36 lakh ko acquisition cost me consider kiya. Department ne mana kiya.
cases.issue: Kya financing interest acquisition cost me include ho sakta hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne financing interest ko acquisition cost me allow kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap loan par investment kar rahe hain toh interest cost bhi acquisition ka hissa ho sakta hai, par proper documents dikhana zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Kallu Ram Vs ITO (ITAT Raipur)
cases.facts: 94 saal ke farmer ne apni appeal late file ki thi, 388 din ki der ho gayi. Department ne is delay ko rok diya tha. Case agriculture ka tha.
cases.issue: Kya itni badi der ke baad bhi appeal consider ki ja sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne delay ko maaf kar diya. Judge ne bola ki age aur circumstances dekhe, ab appeal wapas CIT(A) ke paas bhej di, wahan merits pe sunwayi hogi.
cases.takeaway: Agar genuine reason ho jaise old age ya health, to appeal ki late filing bhi maaf ho sakti hai. Hamesha apne delay ka reason detail me batao.

cases.case_name: Pranav Kirit Inamdar Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Yahan ek aadmi ne NCD kharidi thi aur unko finance lene par 73.36 lakh rupaye ka interest pay kiya. Department ne interest ko cost of acquisition nahi maana.
cases.issue: Kya NCD kharidne ke finance ka interest, cost of acquisition me include ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki yeh interest bhi cost of acquisition ka part hai, isliye allowed hoga.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap security (jaise NCD) kharidne ke liye finance ka interest de rahe ho, to wo cost me jod sakte ho. Documentation saaf rakhna zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Varda Energy and Engineering (ITAT Raipur)
cases.facts: Assessment me department ne 3.91 crore ka bogus purchase pakda. Company ne bataya ki purchase to work-in-progress (WIP) me capitalise ho chuki hai, kharcha expense nahi hua.
cases.issue: Kya WIP me capitalised purchase par bogus purchase ka addition ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya, kyunki purchase WIP me hi hai, income effect realisation time pe hoga.
cases.takeaway: Agar purchase WIP me dala hai, to us par turant bogus addition nahi ho sakta. Sab records sahi aur align honi chahiye balance sheet se.

cases.case_name: Sukhbir Singh Vs Verbio India Private Limited (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Ek aadmi ne company ko advance diya supply ke liye, par supply nahi mili aur paisa wapas bhi nahi mila. Usne company ke khilaf action liya under insolvency laws.
cases.issue: Kya supply advance, jo wapas nahi mila, operational debt maana jayega?
cases.held: NCLAT ne bola ki yeh advance operational debt hai, isliye CIRP proceedings chalengi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka advance supply ke liye atka hua hai, to usko operational debt maankar company ke khilaf insolvency ki action le sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Sumer Builders Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Builder ne apne project me 42.44 crore ka kharcha kiya capital account me. Department ne project se related on-money income par direct tax lagaya bina yeh kharcha consider kiye.
cases.issue: Kya undisclosed on-money income se related project expenditure allow hoga?
cases.held: ITAT ne ye kharcha allow kiya, kaha ki agar on-money dikhaya gaya hai to us project ke related expenditure bhi allow honge.
cases.takeaway: Agar project me on-money disclose hota hai to uska related project expenditure bhi claim kar sakte ho, bas record maintain karo.

cases.case_name: Raj Enterprises Vs DCIT (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Survey me kuch statement diye gaye the, unko base bana kar 7.96 crore ka on-money addition kiya gaya. Assessee ne maan liya ki statements reliable nahi hain.
cases.issue: Kya sirf survey statements par on-money addition kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya, bola ki aise statements par andhi tarah addition nahi ho sakti, concrete evidence chahiye.
cases.takeaway: Sirf statement ki wajah se addition ho raha ho to usko court kaat sakta hai. Hamesha supporting evidences ka dhyan rakho.

cases.case_name: Govardhan Deepchand Bhambhani Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Retired PNB employee ko 7.65 lakh leave encashment par exemption nahi diya gaya. Department ne mana ki yeh eligible nahi hai.
cases.issue: Kya retired PNB employee ko pura leave encashment exemption mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne exemption allow kar di, bola rules ke hisaab se retired bank employees iske liye eligible hain.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap bank se retire ho rahe ho to leave encashment par full exemption claim kar sakte ho, lekin proof submit karo.

cases.case_name: N. Ratnakumar Raju Vs Tamil Nadu Grama Bank (Madras High Court)
cases.facts: Ek bank manager ko galat tareeke se loan dene ke chakkar mein hata diya gaya. Bank ne manager par ilzaam lagaya ki usne niyam se hatkar loans diye.
cases.issue: Kya bank manager ka removal thik tha jab irregular loans diye gaye?
cases.held: Court ne bank manager ki removal decide kar di. Bank ke actions ko support kiya kyunki rules follow nahi hue the.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap banking ya financial sector mein ho, to loan disbursement mein sabhi internal guidelines ka palan karo. Galat loan process se naukri ja sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Transcorp International Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Raipur)
cases.facts: Company ne apni appeal mein CIT(A) ke order ko challenge kiya. Order mein 25 din ki delay thi aur contradictory observations the.
cases.issue: Kya 25 din ki delay ki wajah se CIT(A) ka order valid hai jab unka reasoning contradictory tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne CIT(A) ka galat order radd kar diya. Contradictory reasoning accept nahi ki, isliye assessee ke haq mein decision dia.
cases.takeaway: Agar CIT(A) ke order mein logic clear nahi ya contradict ho, to uske against appeal karna sahi hai.

cases.case_name: DDIT (Investigation)-2(1) Vs Tarun Trikha (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Revenue ne ek aadmi par Rs 23.92 crore ka Black Money Act ka addition laga diya. Baad mein pata chala ki case identity theft ka tha - asal paisa us aadmi ka tha hi nahi.
cases.issue: Kya Black Money Act ka addition sahi tha jab paisa kisi aur ka nikla (identity theft)?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya. Proof mil gaya ki paisa assessee ka nahi hai; identity theft ki wajah se galat case bana tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap par galat ownership ka tax lag jaaye to proper proof collect karo ki paisa aapka nahi hai. Aise cases mein records aur identity documents zaroori hain.

cases.case_name: D.K. Engineering & Construction Vs DCIT (ITAT Raipur)
cases.facts: Engineering & Construction firm ne apna 80-IA deduction claim kiya. CPC ne bina kisike bataye adjustment kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya CPC deduction reject kar sakta hai bina taxpayer ko bataye?
cases.held: ITAT ne CPC ka adjustment hata diya. Bola pehle intimation dena zaroori tha.
cases.takeaway: Jab bhi section 80-IA (infrastructure deduction) pe adjustment ho, notice milne ka wait karo aur sahi document time par bhejo.

cases.case_name: Wilson Rodrigues Vs ITO (ITAT Panaji)
cases.facts: Sarkar ne land acquisition case mein interest par Rs 1.08 crore ka tax laga diya. Yeh interest Section 28 mein mila tha (jo compensation se related hai).
cases.issue: Kya Section 28 land acquisition interest taxable hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne tax delete kar diya. Bola yeh interest compensation ka hissa hai, yeh taxable nahi hai.
cases.takeaway: Land acquisition mein Section 28 ka interest mile to uspe tax nahi dena padta, yeh compensation ka part maana jaata hai.

cases.facts: Service tax mein Rs 2.12 lakh ka dispute tha. Revenue ne extended limitation use ki aur penalty lagayi. Assessee ne bola ki sab neutral hai aur woh CENVAT credit ka bhi eligible hai.
cases.issue: Kya extended limitation aur penalty Section 78 mein lag sakti hai jab revenue neutral hai aur CENVAT credit allowed hai?
cases.held: CESTAT ne extended limitation aur penalty dono hata diye. Bola revenue neutrality aur CENVAT eligibility ki wajah se penalty nahi lagni chahiye thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap CENVAT credit ke liye eligible ho aur revenue neutral hai, toh zyada penalty aur extended limitation ka order challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Shikhar Kailash Infratech Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Is company ke upar search hua. WhatsApp chat ka data mila. Department ne Section 153C mein assessment shuru ki, par Satisfaction Note sahi se nahi banayi.
cases.issue: Kya bas WhatsApp chats aur galat Satisfaction Note pe assessment kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha ki bina valid Satisfaction Note assessment suru nahi ho sakta. WhatsApp chats pe bunkar kaam kiya tha, lekin procedure follow nahi hua tha, isliye order radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke against search assessment chal raha hai to dekho ki Satisfaction Note pe saari legal formalities poori hain ya nahi. Ghalat ya incomplete Note ho to order challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Shree Maruti Chemical Industries Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Company ne apni land ko pehle capital asset ke roop mein dikhaya. Baad mein usko stock-in-trade ke roop mein badal diya. Department ne 4.27 crore ka capital gain add kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya jab land ko stock-in-trade mein convert kiya jaye to turant capital gains lagta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne decide kiya converting ke din pe gain nahi lagta. Section 45(2) ke hisaab se jab sale hoti hai tabhi tax lagega.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap apna capital asset stock-in-trade bana rahe hain, to capital gains tabhi lagega jab actual sale hogi, not on conversion day. Iska proof bhi rakhna hoga.

cases.case_name: Vaibhav Global Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Ye ek jewellery manufacturer ka case tha. Department ne ₹105 crore ka transfer pricing adjustment kar diya aur Berry Ratio use kiya.
cases.issue: Kya Berry Ratio full-fledged manufacturing business par apply hota hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola jewellery manufacturing jaise poore business par Berry Ratio nahi chalega. Isliye puri adjustment hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap manufacturing mein ho, to department agar Berry Ratio lagaye to usko challenge karo. Manufacturing business par ye ratio valid nahi hai.

cases.case_name: Stakeholders Consultation Committee of Shree Mahalaxmi Corporation Private Limited Vs Debdas Chakraborty (NCLT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Company liquidation process chal raha tha. Sare stakeholders ke committee ne unanimously bola ki liquidator ko replace karna hai.
cases.issue: Kya liquidator ko replace kiya ja sakta hai agar SCC saath ho?
cases.held: NCLT ne bola jab sab stakeholders raazi hain to liquidator ko replace kiya ja sakta hai. Court ne SCC ki recommendation maan li.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap stakeholder ho liquidation mein, poori committee milkar liquidator change ke liye apply kare to NCLT sun sakta hai.

cases.case_name: UKG Steel Pvt. Ltd. Vs Erotic Buildcon Pvt. Ltd. (NCLT Delhi)
cases.facts: Yahan ek company ne doosri company ko inter-corporate loan diya, jo Section 186 ki limit violate karta tha. IBC claim bhi file kiya gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya aisa loan jo Section 186 (company loans ki limit) violate karta hai, us par IBC petition admit ho sakti hai?
cases.held: NCLT ne petition dismiss kar di. Bola aisa loan illegal hai, Section 186 violate hota hai to IBC mein paisa nahi mang sakte.
cases.takeaway: Agar inter-corporate loan dena hai, toh Companies Act ki limit cross na ho. Wrong loan pe IBC claim nahi chalega.

cases.case_name: Royal Canin India Private Limited Vs ACIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Company ka franchisee fees aur intra-group services par department ne ₹49.24 crore ka transfer pricing adjustment kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya itni badi adjustment franchisee aur intra-group services pe sahi thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne poori adjustment hata di. Bola ki yahan department ka approach galat tha, business ki saari reality check nahi ki gayi thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap MNC mein ho aur transfer pricing dispute aaye, to department ki adjustment ko detail mein verify karo. Agar business reality ignore hui hai to order ko challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Gold Youth Movement Recreation Club Vs Assistant Commissioner (ST) (Madras High Court)
cases.section: Section 16(5) (ITC eligibility conditions), Section 16(4) (time limit for ITC claim)
cases.facts: Ye case ek club ka tha jisko department ne GST ka Input Tax Credit wapas lene ka order diya tha aur uska bank account bhi freeze kar diya tha. Department ne Section 16(4) ke under ITC reversal ka order pass kiya.
cases.issue: Kya ITC reversal aur bank account freeze ka order sahi tha, jab ki taxpayer ne kuch compliance ki thi.
cases.held: Court ne ITC reversal ka order radd kar diya aur bank account ko defreeze karne ko bola. Judge ne dekha ki Section 16(5) ke kuch requirements complete ho chuke the, isliye assesee ko relief mila.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapne apne GST ITC ke liye major documents pura kiya hai, aur department sirf time limit ke issue par action le raha hai, to court relief de sakta hai. Bank account freeze hone par High Court knock kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Galaxy Developers Vs ACIT (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Yaha ek builder ka case tha. Department ne unsold flats jo abhi bikke nahi the un par notional rent add kar diya aur land acquisition ka expense bhi kuch mana nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya builder ke unsold stock par notional rent add ho sakta hai aur land acquisition ka expense allow ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne notional rent ka addition hata diya aur land acquisition ka 10.31 lakh expense bhi allow kar diya, kyunki yeh AY 2017-18 tha jisme yeh rule lagu nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar builder ho aur AY 2018-19 se pehle ke unsold flats hain to un par notional rent ka addition nahi hona chahiye. Land ke kharche ka sahi proof ho to wo bhi allow ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Shree Kishna Chemicals Vs Union of India and Others (Madhya Pradesh High Court)
cases.facts: Taxpayer ko GST ITC show-cause notice mila tha. Usne High Court mein challenge kiya ki notice sahi nahi hai kyunki unhone supplier se maal kharida hai.
cases.issue: Kya show-cause notice ko bina authority ke samne reply kiye, court mein sidha challenge kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki notice ka answer authority ke samne do. Sidha court aane ki zarurat nahi. Section 16(2)(c) ki condition bhi yahi bolti hai ki invoice dispute authority ke samne uthao.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko GST ITC ka show-cause notice mila hai to pehle department ke samne reply karo. Sidha High Court jane ka support nahi milega.

cases.case_name: A.M. Mohan Vs State Represented by SHO and Another (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Yeh case ek land seller ke against cheating case tha. Complaint lagayi gayi ki usne buyer ko galat fahmi mein paisa kara diya tha. Par aisa koi evidence nahi mila ki land seller ne buyer ko dhokha dene ki niyat se induce kiya ho.
cases.issue: Kya sirf property bechne par cheating ka case banta hai jab tuk dishonest inducement na mile?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne FIR aur chargesheet radd kar di. Court ne bola joh bhi Section 415/420 IPC mein cheating hai usme sabse important hai 'dishonest inducement', jo is case mein nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap property bech rahe ho aur koi criminal complaint cheating ki without aapke dishonest intention ke, to Supreme Court se relief mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Mahindra Homes Private Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Yeh real estate company ka case hai. Department ne CCD (compulsorily convertible debentures) par diye interest ko arms length price se zyada maana aur TP adjustment kar diya. Saath hi professional fees aur advertisement expenses bhi allow nahi kiye.
cases.issue: Kya CCD interest par transfer pricing adjustment justified tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne ₹16.45 crore ka TP adjustment hata diya aur professional fees, advertisement aur miscellaneous expenses allow kiye. Judge ne dekha ki interest market rate par tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap CCD issue karte ho to transfer pricing ki detailing proper rakhni chahiye. Agar interest market rate par hai to department ka TP adjustment tikau nahi rahta.

cases.case_name: Baharul Islam & Ors. Vs Indian Medical Association & Ors. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Assam mein 2004 ka rural medical diploma law banaya gaya tha. Supreme Court ne yeh law radd kar diya. Lekin 2015 ka Community Health Professionals Act sahi mana gaya.
cases.issue: Kya Assam ki state legislature ko yeh law banane ka adhikar tha?
cases.held: Court ne kaha 2004 ka diploma law valid nahi hai. 2015 waale law ko court ne sahi bataya.
cases.takeaway: Agar koi purana state medical diploma law hai, toh check kar lo ki Supreme Court ne use valid mana hai ya nahi. Naya law ho toh bhi uska status confirm karo.

cases.case_name: Kona Seema Co-operative Housing Society Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Ek housing society ne co-operative bank se interest kamaya. Department ne us par deduction dene se mana kiya.
cases.issue: Kya co-operative bank ke interest par Section 80P(2)(d) ka deduction mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT Mumbai ne bola ki society ko poora deduction milega. 5.74 lakh ka interest exempt hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap co-operative housing society ho aur kisi co-op bank se interest milta hai, toh Section 80P(2)(d) ka deduction confidently claim karo.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Pankajbhai Jaysukhlal Shah (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Reassessment notice ek aise officer ne diya jo assessee ke jurisdiction mein nahi tha. Pehle hi lower courts ne notice radd kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya non-jurisdictional officer ka assessment notice valid hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne revenue ki appeal kharij kar di. Matlab non-jurisdictional officer ka notice valid nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko notice aapke asli AO ke alawa kisi aur ne diya hai toh turant challenge karo. Valid nahi maana jayega.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Manish Financial (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Manish Financial ka reassessment 2015-16 ke liye hua. Department ne wrong approval li aur time limit bhi paar ho gayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment valid hai jab approval galat ho aur time limit cross ho gayi ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment radd kar diya. Section 151 ka approval galat tha aur notice late diya gaya tha.
cases.takeaway: Reassessment notice mila ho toh sanction aur date dono check karo. Agar time limit cross hai ya approval galat hai toh assessment radd ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Juniper Networks India Private Limited Vs PCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Juniper Networks ne CSR donation diya aur uspe Section 80G deduction claim kiya. PCIT ne Section 263 ke under order revise kar diya, bola deduction allowed nahi hai.
cases.issue: Kya CSR donations par Section 80G ka deduction mil sakta hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne PCIT ka revision order radd kar diya. Bola CSR donation par Section 80G deduction allowed hai, Section 37(1) se pura ban nahi lagta.
cases.takeaway: Agar CSR donation kiya hai to dhang se receipt aur donee ka details submit karo. Section 80G deduction confidently claim kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Nirmal Bang Securities P. Ltd. Vs PCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Nirmal Bang Securities ne CSR donation par 80G ka claim kiya aur AO ne bina enquiry allowed kar diya. PCIT ne revision kiya kyunki investigate nahi hua tha.
cases.issue: Kya Section 263 ka revision sahi hai jab AO ne CSR deduction without enquiry allow ki?
cases.held: ITAT ne PCIT ka revision sahi maana. Bola AO ko enquiry karni chahiye thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar 80G ya CSR claim kar rahe ho to AO ko pura evidence upfront do. Varna PCIT revision ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Deepak Kanubhai Bhatt Vs Assessing Officer (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Ek aadmi ne Section 80GGC ka claim return mein kiya tha, baad mein woh claim withdraw kar diya. Department ne bina specific misreporting clause bataye ₹3.74 lakh ka penalty dala.
cases.issue: Kya jab notice mein misreporting ki clause likhi hi nahi, to penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola notice mein misreporting clause nahi bataya, isliye penalty radd kar di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko Section 270A penalty ka notice aaye, to check karo usmein misreporting ya underreporting ka clause clearly likha hai ya nahi. Nahi likha to penalty illegal hogi.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Mahima Sahu (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Taxpayer ne Section 111A ka short-term capital gain dikhaya tha. Revenue ne Section 87A ka ₹24,995 rebate deny kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya Section 87A rebate STCG par bhi mil sakta hai, jab gain Section 111A mein ayega?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola Section 87A rebate yahan valid hai. Revenue ki appeal kharij kar di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke total income limit ke andar hai, to Section 87A rebate STCG (Section 111A) par bhi claim kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Shantilal Mafaji Kachchhava Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Assessing Officer ne ₹3.13 lakh ka addition kiya Section 69C mein. Evidence taxpayer ko dikhaya hi nahi. Income presumptive basis par thi (Section 44AD).
cases.issue: Kya bina taxpayer ko documents dikhaye Section 69C ka addition sahi hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola jab tak incriminating evidence assessee ko na dikhaya jaye, addition valid nahi hai. Yahan 44AD bhi apply ho raha tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke khilaaf koi addition ho, to AO se evidence ki copy maang lo. Bina dikhaye addition radd ho sakta hai, khas taur se presumptive income pe.

cases.case_name: Tushar Jayantibhai Thakkar Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Taxpayer par ₹13.53 lakh Section 69A addition lagayi gayi. Taxpayer ne bank statements, ledger aur company ka confirmation diya. Sab documents sahi paaye gaye.
cases.issue: Kya jab genuine documents diye gaye hain, tab bhi Section 69A addition justified hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne decide kiya ki bank statements, ledger aur confirmation sufficient evidence hai. Addition hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke khilaaf unexplained money ka case ho, toh turant apne bank statement, ledger entry aur company ka confirmation letter present karo.

cases.case_name: Bhuvan Kumar Gupta Vs Maverick Developers and Colonisers Pvt. Ltd. & Anr. (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Creditor ne CIRP start karne ke liye application daala. Lekin NeSL record mein dispute dikh raha tha aur creditor ko bhi pehle se pata tha.
cases.issue: Kya pre-existing dispute ki wajah se CIRP admission radd ho sakta hai?
cases.held: NCLAT ne bola ki NeSL record mein jab dispute pehle se recorded hai, toh insolvency application allow nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap secured creditor ho aur dispute already NeSL portal par recorded hai to Section 9 IBC mein insolvency claim bar ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Vijay Kumar Singhania Vs Bank of Baroda and Anr (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Corporate debtor par IBC Section 7 ke tahat insolvency proceeding daali gayi. NCLAT ne alternative evidence of default aur OTS acknowledgement bhi accept ki.
cases.issue: Kya alternative evidence of default, jaise OTS documents, IBC proceedings mein chalega?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne NCLAT ka decision uphold kiya. Court ne bola OTS acknowledgement bhi default prove karne ke liye valid hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap kisi loan default par insolvency process start kar rahe ho, to OTS documents ya alternative default ki bhi value hai.

cases.case_name: Raysinh Atabhai Vala Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: BSNL ke kuch employees ne VRS liya. Unko mila hua compensation sarkar ne taxable maana. Appeal daali ki Section 10(10B) ke hisaab se yeh exempt hona chahiye.
cases.issue: Kya BSNL ka VRS compensation section 10(10B) ki exemption milegi ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, yeh compensation Section 10(10B) ke andar exempt hai. Department ko order diya ki dobara income calculate karo, aur refund banta ho toh wapas karo.
cases.takeaway: BSNL VRS lene wale employees ko section 10(10B) exemption claim karni chahiye. Agar refund banta hai toh department se follow up karein.

cases.case_name: Nascent Info Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Company ne PF aur ESI ka payment time pe nahi kiya, jisse expense disallow ho gaya. Income tax officer ne ₹4.43 lakh penalty laga di misreporting ke liye.
cases.issue: Kya sirf PF/ESI disallowance se misreporting proof ho jati hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne bola, sirf late deposit ki wajah se misreporting nahi mana ja sakta. Penalty hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar PF/ESI ka payment late ho gaya hai aur penalty lag gayi ho, toh appeal mein challenge kiya ja sakta hai. Sirf disallowance pe penalty nahi lagti.

cases.case_name: Bank of Baroda & Anr. Vs Parasaadilal Tursiram Sheetgrah Pvt. Ltd. & Ors. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Ek SARFAESI auction mein bidder ne High Court mein stay le liya tha jabki 45 din ka time limit khatam ho chuka tha. Matter Supreme Court tak gaya.
cases.issue: Kya High Court SARFAESI auction ko 45 din baad bhi rok sakta hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne High Court ka stay order radd kar diya. Court ne bola ki 45 din ke baad challenge allowed nahi hai aur DRT ki power limited hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar SARFAESI auction mein challenge karna hai toh 45 din ke andar DRT mein file karein. High Court directly interfere nahi karegi agar time limit khatam ho gayi hai.

cases.case_name: Anand NVH Products Private Limited Vs National E Assessment Centre Delhi & Anr. (Delhi High Court)
cases.facts: Company ka assessment pending tha aur taxpayer DRP (Dispute Resolution Panel) ke saamne gaya tha. Department ne DRP ka decision aaye bina final assessment order, demand notice aur penalty bhej diya.
cases.issue: Kya DRP ka decision aaye bina assessment order pass kar sakte hain?
cases.held: High Court ne assessment order, demand aur penalty notice sabko radd kar diya kyunki DRP ka decision nahi aaya tha. Proper process follow karna zaroori hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar DRP mein matter pending hai, department assessment order nahi nikal sakta. Aise case mein High Court jaa sakte hain.

cases.case_name: S. S. Iron & Steel & Anr. Vs Union of India and Ors. (Calcutta High Court)
cases.facts: GST department ne kai saal ke liye consolidated show cause notice diya. Party ne direct High Court mein challenge kiya. Department ne bola ki pehle appeal karo.
cases.issue: Kya consolidated GST show cause notice direct High Court mein challenge ki ja sakti hai?
cases.held: High Court ne bola ki abhi statutory appeal u/s 107 available hai, toh High Court direct zahmat nahi karega. Limitation ka objection bhi nahi utha sakte.
cases.takeaway: Agar GST ka consolidated notice mila hai toh pehle Section 107 ke andar appeal file karo, High Court direct nahi jaa sakte.

cases.case_name: Phoenix ARC Private Limited Vs Cherupushpam Films Private Limited (NCLT Kochi)
cases.facts: Phoenix ARC ne loan recover karne section 7 application daali. Lekin unka debt assignment deed theek se stamped nahi tha aur trustee ki authority prove nahi ho paayi.
cases.issue: Kya bina proper stamp duty aur trustee proof ke section 7 IBC case admit ho sakta hai?
cases.held: NCLT ne case dismiss kar diya kyunki deed par sahi stamp nahi thi, aur trustee ki authority clear nahi thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar bank ya ARC insolvency ke liye court jana chahe to pehle debt assignment deed par proper stamp duty de aur trustee ki authority ki document ready rakhe.

cases.case_name: Dickey Special Situation Investment Trust-DSSF Series 2 Vs Manish Agarwal (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Worlds Window Exim ka resolution plan defect tha, default ka reason sahi se address nahi kiya. NCLAT ne plan reject kiya, liquidation order diya aur investigation bhi. Assignee ki recovery par pehle se laga cap hata diya.
cases.issue: Kya defective resolution plan ko accept kiya jaa sakta hai?
cases.held: NCLAT ne resolution plan reject kar diya, liquidation aur investigation ka order diya. Assignee ki recovery par jo cap laga tha, wo hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Resolution plan banate waqt default ka asal reason jarur dikhayein. Varna plan reject ho sakta hai aur company liquidation mein ja sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Pinarayi Vijayan Vs K M Shajahan & Ors. (Supreme Court)
cases.facts: Supreme Court ne ek High Court ke FIR direction ke khilaaf appeal lagane ka haq diya. Investigation 10 din ke liye rok di. ECIR ki validiity ka mudda abhi decide nahi hua.
cases.issue: Kya High Court ke FIR direction ke khilaaf Supreme Court me appeal ho sakti hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne appeal wapas bahal ki aur 10 din ke liye investigation roki. Case ki merits abhi decide nahi hui.
cases.takeaway: Agar FIR direction se problem hai to Supreme Court se interim protection mil sakti hai. Par court merits alag se dekhegi.

cases.case_name: VCO Consultants and Services Private Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: VCO Consultants ke case mein 1302 din tak delay ho gaya PF/ESI disallowance ki appeal file karne mein. Issue ₹43.48 lakh ka tha. Section 143(1) ki challenge bhi pending thi.
cases.issue: Itne lambi delay mein appeal allow karni chahiye ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne delay condone kiya aur matter dobara dekhne ko wapas bhej diya. Saath hi Section 143(1) wali baat bhi fresh examine hogi.
cases.takeaway: Agar appeal late ho jaye to genuine reason ho to delay condone ho sakti hai. PF/ESI disallowance pe fresh hearing mil sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Shreeji Developers & Anr. Vs State of Gujarat & Ors. (Gujarat High Court)
cases.facts: Shreeji Developers ke khilaf duplicate GSTR-1 entries ki wajah se GST demand thi. Hearing ka mauka nahi mila tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina sunwai diye GST demand lagana sahi hai?
cases.held: High Court ne GST demand radd kar di. Personal hearing ke saath dobara case sunne ka order diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar notice milti hai to personal hearing jarur maangein. Duplicate entries par bina sunwai ke demand nahi ho sakti.

cases.case_name: H.M. Traders Vs Goods and Services Tax Officer (Delhi High Court)
cases.facts: H.M. Traders ka GST SCN portal ke additional notices tab mein upload hua, jo unko dikha nahi. Is wajah se order pass ho gaya.
cases.issue: Kya galat jagah notice upload karne se order valid rahega?
cases.held: Court ne order hata diya aur fresh hearing ka mauka diya. Notification ki validity baad mein decide hogi.
cases.takeaway: SCN portal par check karo ki notice kahaan upload hui hai. Galat tab mein ho to turant objection bhejo.

cases.case_name: Warmmax India Vs Commissioner of the SGST and Another (Jharkhand High Court)
cases.facts: Warmmax India par GST Section 73 mein 27 April 2024 ko order aaya bina personal hearing ke. Company ne iske khilaf court mein case kiya.
cases.issue: Kya bina personal hearing ke GST ka order sahi hai?
cases.held: Court ne GST order radd kar diya. Judge ne fresh hearing ke baad dobara adjudicate karne ko kaha.
cases.takeaway: Section 73 ka notice aaye to personal hearing ki demand likhit mein jarur karein. Dobara notice milne par sab document ready rakhein.

cases.case_name: Satish Vohra and Others Vs State of Punjab and Another (Punjab and Haryana High Court)
cases.facts: Income tax prosecution pehli se settlement ho gaya tha aur Benami Act ki findings final thi. Court ne aage prosecution chalana bekaar samjha.
cases.issue: Kya settlement ke baad income tax prosecution chal sakti hai?
cases.held: Court ne saaf kaha ki prosecution ka koi fayda nahi, isliye case khatam kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar settlement proceedings puri ho jayen aur Benami case ka final order aa jaye to prosecution radd ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: VCO Consultants and Services Private Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Yahan ek company thi jo service business karti thi. Department ne PF aur ESI ki payment late hone par Rs. 43.48 lakh ka disallowance kara aur Section 143(1) ke through issue uthaya. Appeal mein company ne 1,302 din der se file ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya itni zyada delay condone ki ja sakti hai aur disallowance wapas se check ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne company ka delay maaf kar diya. Saari baat wapas Assessing Officer ko fresh check ke liye bhej di, saath hi Section 143(1) ka challenge bhi include kara.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka appeal kaafi der se bhi file hua ho, lekin reason genuine hai, to delay condone ho sakta hai. PF/ESI disallowance par fresh hearing mil sakti hai, saare facts dubara rakhna zaruri hai.

cases.case_name: Shreeji Developers & Anr. Vs State of Gujarat & Ors. (Gujarat High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan developer ka case tha jisme GSTR-1 form mein entry galti se do baar ho gayi. Department ne iski basis par GST demand nikal di bina proper sunwai ke.
cases.issue: Kya bina sunwai diye GST demand nikalna sahi hai agar duplicate entry ho?
cases.held: High Court ne department ka demand order radd kar diya. Matter fresh sunwai aur personal hearing ke liye wapas bhej diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke GST records mein mistake ho jaaye, to apni baat rakhne ka mauka milna chahiye. Bina sunwai ke final demand nahi ban sakta.

cases.case_name: Satish Vohra and Others Vs State of Punjab and Another (Punjab and Haryana High Court)
cases.facts: Is case mein taxpayer par income tax ki prosecution chal rahi thi. Baad mein settlement proceed hua aur Benami Act ke tehat property ka final faisla bhi ho gaya tha.
cases.issue: Final settlement aur Benami Act finding ke baad prosecution continue ho sakti hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Court ne prosecution radd kar di. Bola ki settlement ho chuka hai to fir criminal case chala kar fayda nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar settlement ya Benami ka order ho jaaye, to criminal prosecution bhi khatam ho sakta hai. Dono side ka faisla ek saath nahi chal sakta.

cases.case_name: H.M. Traders Vs Goods and Services Tax Officer (Delhi High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan ek trader ka GST case tha. Department ne show cause notice (SCN) Additional Notices tab mein daal diya, isliye party ko pata hi nahi chala. Baad mein department ne order pass kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya bina proper notice diye order pass karna sahi hai GST mein?
cases.held: Court ne GST order ko radd kar diya. Bola ki party ko mauka dena zaruri hai aur poora notice sahi jagah upload karna chahiye.
cases.takeaway: Hamesha verify karo ki koi notice portal par kahan upload hua. Agar SCN galat tab mein hai aur party ko nahi pata, to order invalidate ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Indian Roadways Corporation Ltd. Vs PCIT (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Is case mein IT Department ne ek company ke khilaaf completed assessment mein Section 263 revision start kar diya. Search mein koi naya document ya incriminating material nahi mila tha.
cases.issue: Kya sirf suspicion pe Section 263 revision ho sakta hai jab koi nayi evidence nahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 263 revision quash kar di. Bola ki bina incriminating material ke completed assessment ko dubara nahi khola ja sakta.
cases.takeaway: Aapke case mein agar search hui ho par kuch bhi naya document nahi mile, to completed assessment ko revision se bachaya ja sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Warmmax India Vs Commissioner of the SGST and Another (Jharkhand High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan ek GST registered company ka case tha. Department ne Section 73 ke under tax demand banaya par bina personal hearing diye order pass ho gaya.
cases.issue: Kya bina personal hearing diye Section 73 order valid hai?
cases.held: High Court ne order cancel kar diya. Bola ki bina sunwai diye order banana galat hai – ab company ko neya chance milega apni baat rakhne ka.
cases.takeaway: Jab bhi aapko Section 73 ka notice mile, hearing ka mauka zarur mangna chahiye. Personal hearing na mile to order radd ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Samarth Nagari Shakari Path Sanstha Maryadit Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Ek co-operative society ka case tha. Society ne apne profit par Section 80P ka deduction claim kiya tha. Department ne is par objection uthaya.
cases.issue: Society ko Section 80P ka deduction milna chahiye ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne society ko ₹33.23 lakh ka deduction allow kiya. Court ne Supreme Court ke Mavilayi aur Rena Sahakari decisions ka sahara liya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap co-operative society hain, to Section 80P deduction claim karne ke liye Supreme Court ke mawjud decisions ka hindi me reference ready rakhiye.

cases.case_name: Dakshinamoorthy Kumaresan Vs ITO (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ek aadmi par penalty lagayi gayi thi. Notice mein likha tha ki galat particulars diye hain, lekin order mein concealment bola tha.
cases.issue: Jab notice aur order alag charges dikhayein to penalty lagi reh sakti hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty radd kar di. Reason yeh tha ki notice aur penalty order mein alag alag kaaran diye gaye the.
cases.takeaway: Agar notice aur penalty order mein alag alag offence likha hai, to aap penalty challenge kar sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Saroj Kumar Haldar Vs ITO (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: BSNL ke kuch retirees ne VRS compensation par exemption claim kiya tha. Assessing Officer ne in appeals ko mana kar diya tha.
cases.issue: VRS-2019 compensation par Section 10(10B) exemption milni chahiye ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne exemption allow kar di. Yeh decision pehle ITAT ke similar cases ko dekh kar diya gaya.
cases.takeaway: Aap BSNL ya kisi PSU VRS-2019 retiree hain, to Section 10(10B) exemption ka claim confidently daal sakte hain, lekin saare documents ready rakhein.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Rakesh Kumar Malani (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Ek assessee ne short-term capital gains par Section 87A ka rebate claim kiya. Department ne mana kar diya kyunki yeh STCG Section 111A ke under aata tha.
cases.issue: Section 111A STCG par 87A rebate milti hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT Jaipur ne decision diya ki Section 87A rebate STCG par bhi mil sakti hai agar AY 2025-26 hai. Revenue ki appeal kharij ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke short-term capital gains Section 111A ke under hain to bhi Section 87A rebate mil sakti hai, khas taur par AY 2025-26 ke liye.

cases.case_name: Vikas Ashokkumar Masand Vs DCIT (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Ek petrol pump owner ne demonetisation ke time cash collect kiya tha. Department ne Section 69A mein addition kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Demonetisation period ka cash, agar proper business records hain, to Section 69A mein add ho sakta hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya. Unhone dekha ki cash receipts business ke ledgers aur debtor records se match ho rahi thi.
cases.takeaway: Demonetisation ke samay ka cash deposit justify karna hai to debtor ledger aur business record ready rakho; sahi proof ho to addition delete ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Saiyed Zaharul Alam Vs ITO (ITAT Kolkata)
